experiment: E1 detector plus learned ROI classifier for Lighter and Knife
selection: ROI classifier checkpoint by val mean recall over 12 objects; per-target blending selected only on calib detection metrics before test
negative_sampling: one hard detector false positive per train/val image if its expanded crop covers <=5% of every GT, otherwise deterministic random background
caveat: Inference uses detector proposals only, never GT crops. Existing tests are reused exploratory data, not a new independent holdout. Detector and non-target outputs remain unchanged. No adoption without target improvement and E2 review.
